title: One report froze the field.
description:
One report froze the field. In 1972 Britain's Science Research Council asked an outsider to survey artificial intelligence. He was a fluid dynamicist, not a computer scientist.

His survey concluded that in no part of the field had the discoveries produced 'the major impact that was then promised.' British funding collapsed; the work survived at just Edinburgh, Essex and Sussex.

The general purpose robot is a mirage. The BBC staged the debate under that title in its Controversy series: Lighthill versus McCarthy, Michie and Gregory at the Royal Institution, May 1973. The recording still circulates.

AI winter, after nuclear winter. Coined at a 1984 AAAI debate, where Schank and Minsky warned the new boom would collapse the same way. Three years later the billion-dollar AI industry did.

The second winter arrived on schedule.
